author: felicepantaleo
body:
This PR adds the parameter `requireHits` to `TruthBranchTrackValidator`, `TruthBranchTracksterValidator` and `TruthBranchPFClusterValidator`. When it is true, a truth-to-reco denominator member is counted only when its subgraph has a hit in the detectors of the validated collection: the `denominatorDetectors` of the domain's associator (Tracker for tracks, HGCAL for tracksters, Ecal and Hcal for the PF clusters). The default is false, so the default output does not change.

- One list, `truthBranchDenominatorDetectors` in `truthGraphAssociationLabels_cff`, feeds the associators and the validators. `BranchHitAssociator::detectorMask` parses it for both, so the two cannot differ.
- The `signalNoSelection` denominator is exempt: it has no cut at all.
- `Validation/TruthInfo/customiseTruthBranchRequireHits` turns `requireHits` on for every hit-based validator of the process.
- The cut is in the validator and not in `TruthBranchTargetsProducer`, because one target list serves every domain and only the validator knows its detectors.
title: Validation/TruthInfo: optional hit requirement for the truth-to-reco denominators
